### loop-pct-var | kinds=unknown | flags=compound
for i in 101 102 103; do pct exec $i -- uptime; done

### loop-pct-literal | kinds=read | flags=compound | inner=pct:101
for i in 101 102 103; do pct exec 101 -- uptime; done

### if-block | kinds=read,read | flags=compound
if [ -f /etc/os-release ]; then cat /etc/os-release; fi

### case-block | kinds=write | flags=compound
case "$x" in a) rm -rf /tmp/synthetic-dir ;; esac

### recon-script | kinds=read,read,read,read,read,read,read,write | flags= | sections=UPTIME,DISK,LOGS,SERVICES
echo "=== UPTIME ==="
uptime
echo "=== DISK ==="
df -h /
echo "=== LOGS ==="
journalctl -u nginx --since today --no-pager | grep -i error | tail -n 20
echo "=== SERVICES ==="
systemctl is-active nginx
docker ps
sed -i 's/a/b/' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
